subject: Sprint agreement & billing trigger plan for ByteLeap evaluation
messages:
From: Ana Morales <ana@byteleap.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@byteleap.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation timeline and procurement path

Hi Michael / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. We're mapping next steps internally and want to align on two things before we kick off the 30-day evaluation sprint:

1) A short mutual plan that ties the evaluation milestones to delivery and pricing expectations. Specifically, our security and procurement teams want to know what milestone (if any) will trigger invoicing and whether Redwood will accept a PO prior to the billing start date.

2) Any trial/credit mechanics and how discounts would be applied if we convert to a committed plan (we typically require a signed SOW + PO for our finance process).

Can you share a draft we can circulate? We're aiming to start the evaluation the week of Jun 7 and would like commercial clarity before then.

Best,
Ana
Ana Morales
Head of Platform Operations, ByteLeap

--
Attachment: evaluation-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet summary)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Morales <ana@byteleap.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint agreement & billing trigger plan for ByteLeap evaluation

Ana — great to hear. I've drafted a short sprint agreement (attached) that ties the MAP milestones to commercial triggers and includes payment/invoice mechanics. High level:

- Evaluation window: 30 days (Jun 7 — Jul 6).
- Billing start: For customers who accept a paid conversion during or at the end of the evaluation, billing will start on the date of signature of the SOW, unless the PO specifies a later invoice start date. If ByteLeap requires a PO prior to signature, Redwood will accept a PO and note the desired invoice start date in the SOW.
- Trial credit: We offer a $5k evaluation credit applied on first invoice if conversion happens within 14 days of evaluation end.
- Commitment discounts: 10% off list for a 6-month minimum commit (>= $75k), 18% for 12-month commit with staged ramp milestones. Discounts apply to the committed baseline usage; overage billed at standard rates.
- Payment terms: Default Net30 for hosted customers. We can accept Net60 if procurement provides a PO and a finance contact for statement-of-work billing. Net60 requests beyond $250k ARR would need finance approval.
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly in arrears by default. Quarterly invoicing possible for committed contracts > $150k/quarter.

I've attached Draft-Sprint-Agreement-v1.pdf and a short pricing ladder. Laura / Karthik — tagging you for the discount ladder confirmation and PO acceptance wording.

Next steps: 1) Ana: confirm PO path and whether ByteLeap insists on invoice start aligned to PO date; 2) Redwood: finalise SOW with explicit billing start and discount tiers.

Regards,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Draft-Sprint-Agreement-v1.pdf, Pricing-Ladder-2027.csv

From: Ana Morales <ana@byteleap.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint agreement & billing trigger plan for ByteLeap evaluation

Thanks Michael — this is helpful. Two clarifications from procurement: 1) We will provide a PO before the start of the paid term, but we need the invoice start date to be explicitly set in the SOW (we sometimes have project-specific budgets that dictate the start of invoicing). 2) For Net60: acceptable only if the PO references Net60 and the total first-year committed spend is > $100k.

Also, will the $5k credit reduce our first invoice amount or be issued as a credit memo?

Happy to review the draft sprint agreement; please turn the SOW language around where the billing start date is a required field we populate on signature.

Best,
Ana

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Morales <ana@byteleap.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint agreement & billing trigger plan for ByteLeap evaluation

Ana — appreciate the procurement flags. Quick clarifications from Redwood's side so we put the right language in the SOW and invoice workflows:

- Invoice start date field: we will add a required "Billing Start Date" in the SOW. If a PO is provided prior to that date and it specifies a different start date, Redwood will honor the PO start date provided it is explicitly referenced in the SOW signature block.
- PO acceptance: our finance team will accept a PO emailed to ap@redwood.ai; please CC the Redwood finance contact listed in the SOW.
- Credit handling: the $5k evaluation credit will be applied as a one-time line-item credit on the first invoice after conversion (not as a separate credit memo), unless ByteLeap prefers a credit memo — we can do either.
- Discounts & ramp: discount tiers will be reflected against the committed baseline. We will include a simple ramp schedule (month-by-month baseline targets) and an overage clause at list rates.

Karthik — caveat on Net60 threshold and quarterly invoicing options. Michael — can you confirm whether we should allow ByteLeap to request quarterly invoices for the committed term?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Morales <ana@byteleap.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, michael_grant@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint agreement & billing trigger plan for ByteLeap evaluation

Ana / team — finance here. Operational notes to include in the SOW and PO checklist:

- AP contact: ap@redwood.ai (Net30 by default). For Net60 requests please add "Net60" to the PO terms and include the finance approver name/email.
- Invoice delivery: invoices are sent via email to billing@byteleap.com and can also be uploaded to a shared SFTP if required (we can add SFTP details in the SOW).
- Failed PO/PO mismatch: if PO line items don't match the signed SOW, we will raise a query and billing will be paused until reconciliation (standard ops).
- Billing start date: if the SOW billing start date is after the PO date, we will hold invoicing until the billing start date but reserve the right to pro-rate usage charges for the first billing period if agreed.

I'll add these operational bullets to the draft. Also: we will accept a PO prior to signature provided the SOW references the PO number and the signature block is countersigned within 30 days.

-Karthik
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: ByteLeap-SOW.xlsx

From: Ana Morales <ana@byteleap.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint agreement & billing trigger plan for ByteLeap evaluation

Thanks everyone — this gives procurement what they need. A couple quick confirmations:

- ByteLeap will issue a PO (PO-2027-556) next week and will set the billing start date in the SOW to Jul 1, 2027.
- We accept the $5k credit applied as a line-item on the first invoice.
- We will plan for a 6-month commit (baseline $85k) with a 10% discount on committed baseline; we may expand to 12 months pending pilot results.

Please push an updated SOW with the billing start date field and PO acceptance language and we'll circulate for signature.

Looking forward to the pilot.

Ana
